# llms.txt — LLM-Readable Project Description

> This file provides context for Large Language Models working with this codebase.

## Project

The Pride of Tirumala (TPT) Apartment Expense Tracker — a Progressive Web App for managing apartment maintenance finances.

## Stack

- React 19 + Vite 8 (frontend framework)
- Google Sheets API v4 (database — no backend server)
- Google Drive API v3 (file storage for receipts and backups)
- Google Identity Services (OAuth 2.0 authentication)
- jsPDF (client-side PDF report generation)
- Tesseract.js v5 `eng` (on-device receipt OCR; no cloud, no API key)
- Web Speech API (on-device voice fill; Chrome/Safari; no cloud model)
- vite-plugin-pwa (service worker for offline support)
- Vitest (unit tests)
- Vanilla CSS with custom properties (design system)
- Lucide React (icon library)
- React Router with HashRouter (routing)

## Purpose

Track monthly maintenance collection (₹3,000/flat × 10 flats), log expenses with receipt uploads, voice or camera fill, generate monthly PDF reports, manage emergency contacts and recurring reminders. Optional Activity Funds each have their own reusable Google Sheet.

**The Google Sheet is the single source of truth.** Adding a row on Maintenance, Expenses, Configuration, Payees, or Handover Summary and refreshing the app must show that change. The app never invents owner names or UPI IDs.

## Society workbook (critical)

There is **one history workbook** named `The Pride of Tirumala-APP` and **one founding owner**. From Aug 2026 the working cash book is a second file, `The Pride of Tirumala-LIVE`, created only by that owner.

- File aliases for history: `The Pride of Tirumala-APP` and `The Pride of Tirumala-APP.xlsx`. Ignore `The Pride of Tirumala-APP-old` and `TPT-MaintenanceTracker`.
- The app **never creates** `TPT-MaintenanceTracker` or any replacement APP file. LIVE is additive.
- If Drive only has the `.xlsx`, convert: Drive → Open with Google Sheets → File → Save as Google Sheets, keep the name `The Pride of Tirumala-APP`
- Setup **backs up first**, then adds empty app tabs beside the five history tabs
- History tabs (never overwrite): Summary, Exp - Detailed, Borewell Exp, Motor repair oct, Notes
- A Drive copy is taken before first Setup, before creating LIVE, and on every Google sign-in (APP and LIVE if bound; not Guest PIN)
- `#/old` is a read-only view of the APP Summary grid (including surplus/deficit as stored) plus handover totals
- LIVE Live Summary: formulas from Maintenance and Expenses. Starts with Aug-26 only; append the next month from the app. Do not type collection/expense amounts there. Opening available balance is the APP Summary green cell at create (already includes August as of that cell). Monthly surplus (deficit) and running available balance are formulas.
- Available balance on APP is the green Summary cell, copied into Configuration. It is not a `DEFAULT_CONFIG` number. Old surplus/deficit rows are not imported as collections.
- `public/sheet-config.json` holds the published APP spreadsheet ID. Do not invent a LIVE id in source.
- Sample live-tab data is compile-time off (`FEATURES.SAMPLE_DATA`)
- Payees: add in the app or on the Payees tab. GPay/PhonePe use a 10-digit phone (PhonePe `number@ybl`). UPI ID is optional and overrides the phone. Duplicates (same phone or same UPI) are rejected. Expenses with the same date, description, and amount are rejected.

## Access model (critical)

- Founding owner email: `th***@gmail.com` (full value only in `src/config/accessPolicy.js`)
- Only that account may **connect and extend** the APP spreadsheet and **create The Pride of Tirumala-LIVE**
- Other Google accounts must **never** be auto-promoted to Owner and must **never** upload a second tracker
- Creating LIVE shares it with Active Access Control emails from APP. Adding a user shares **both** files.
- The founding owner adds users in **Settings → Access Control**. Default role is **Reader**
- Readers are shared the existing sheet as Google Drive **Viewer** (`reader`). Owners (if granted) get **writer**
- The founding owner cannot be removed or demoted
- Max 20 users, max 2 Owners (founding + at most one additional, granted only by the founding owner)
- Members discover the sheet via Drive `sharedWithMe` (scope includes `drive.metadata.readonly`)
- Optional published ID: `public/sheet-config.json` `{ "spreadsheetId": "..." }` — only if that file is named The Pride of Tirumala-APP
- App write APIs use `withWriteAuth` so Readers cannot mutate through the UI even if Drive still has leftover writer
- Private copies a non-founding user created in their own Drive are **ignored**
- Bound files named `TPT-MaintenanceTracker` are unbound so the APP file can be found

Policy helpers live in `src/config/accessPolicy.js` and must be reused rather than copying role checks.

## Key Files

- `src/config/accessPolicy.js` — Founding owner, default Reader, grant rules
- `src/config/constants.js` — Sheet name, aliases, feature flags, OAuth scopes. No LATE_FEE / LATE_FEE_AFTER_DAY / EMERGENCY_RESERVE / AVAILABLE_BALANCE defaults.
- `src/utils/setupFlow.js` — `shouldOfferSheetCreation` is always false
- `src/utils/sheetRangeError.js` — Detect missing-tab Sheets errors so Dashboard can add app tabs and retry
- `src/utils/legacySheetImport.js` — Parse Summary collections + expense categories and Exp-Detailed into app rows. Summary Sundry totals are not copied (already on Exp-Detailed). Matching totals are not imported twice.
- `src/utils/helpers.js` — `sheetAvailableBalance` reads Configuration (sheet copy of the Summary cell)
- `src/data/handoverLedger.js` — Nov 2020–Aug 2026 totals (no owner names; not a live balance default)
- `src/services/googleAuth.js` — OAuth 2.0 authentication (re-consent when scopes bump)
- `src/services/googleSheets.js` — All CRUD operations (the "backend")
- `src/services/googleDrive.js` — Discovery of The Pride of Tirumala-APP, backups (Drive copy, then Sheets clone if drive.file blocks copy), sharing
- `src/services/sheetSetup.js` — `ensureSheetStructure` adds missing app tabs; `syncCollectionsFromSummary` updates Maintenance + Monthly Summary from Summary; `createSpreadsheet` throws
- `src/services/sheetFormulas.js` — Still Due and Monthly Summary formulas (app UI does not use surplus/deficit)
- `src/services/pdfExport.js` — Monthly + activity PDFs
- `src/services/activityFunds.js` — Optional named funds; one Drive spreadsheet per activity
- `src/utils/gapi.js` — Wrap gapi thenables so `.catch` works on phones (`gapiCall` / `gapiCallSafe`). Never call `.catch` on a raw gapi thenable.
- `src/utils/sheetCorrections.js` — Dashboard banner when Live Summary / Still Due formulas disagree with app totals
- `src/utils/voiceExpense.js` — Web Speech + local parse; never auto-submits
- `src/utils/receiptOcr.js` — Local Tesseract; user must review before save
- `docs/architecture.png` — High-level architecture PNG
- `src/contexts/AuthContext.jsx` — Auth state; Google sign-in triggers a Drive backup once per session
- `src/pages/Setup.jsx` — Founding-owner connect wizard + Drive convert steps
- `src/pages/Handover.jsx` — Handover totals; also embedded on `#/old`
- `src/pages/OldReport.jsx` — Read-only APP Summary grid
- `src/services/liveSheetSetup.js` — Create/connect The Pride of Tirumala-LIVE
- `src/config/liveWorkbook.js` — Old Summary expense labels for Live Summary
- `vite.config.js` — Build config with PWA and chunk splitting

## Constraints

- Max 20 users, max 2 owners
- 10 flats: 101, 102, 201, 202, 301, 302, 401, 402, 501, 502
- No backend server — fully client-side static hosting. Drive file ACL is the real write barrier
- Must be deployable to GitHub Pages and Azure Static Web Apps
- PWA installable on iOS, Android, and desktop
- Fiscal year: September to August
- Indian Rupee (₹) currency formatting in the app and in generated PDFs
- PDF reports mask emails and phone numbers
- Existing workbooks can be upgraded (Settings → Backups → Refresh sheet layout)
- UI must remain usable on mobile (hamburger + bottom nav, stacked cards, 44px tap targets)
- Do not hardcode owner names from the Excel into JS source. Runtime copy from Summary → Flats is allowed

## Deployment

- GitHub Pages: Push to main → auto-deployed via GitHub Actions
- Azure Static Web Apps: Connected to GitHub, auto-deploys
- Base path: `/AppartmentApp/` for GitHub Pages
- After connecting the society sheet, optionally paste the ID into `public/sheet-config.json`
- After deploy: hard-refresh or Settings → Appearance → Clear cache so the new PWA cache loads
